setup.supportGapConvention: signed vertical clearance to Float32 emitted asphalt minus existing .04 render lift; negative is penetration
setup.asphaltGapConvention: signed vertical clearance to actual emitted Float32 Batch.geometry triangles; negative is penetration
setup.sampling: actual tyre meshes and wheel bottoms every Player update; all visible body mesh vertices at placement, settle .25/.5/1/3s, motion1/2/4s
setup.bodyDefinition: all visible real Player Mesh vertices; nonWheelBody excludes descendants of real wheel steering groups
setup.limitations: Synthetic planar surface contact diagnostic only; no bank runtime implementation, UI, source-city feasibility, camera, or publication claims
